title: Then She Was Gone
author: Lisa Jewell
summary: Ten years after her fifteen-year-old daughter vanished, Laurel begins a relationship with a man whose young daughter looks startlingly like the girl she lost. Her search for answers begins again.
readIf: you like domestic suspense that mixes grief with a creeping sense that something is wrong.
skipIf: you do not want a story about a missing child.

pairings.reason: Another family-centred thriller where a child's disappearance exposes what the adults hide.
A gentler, more reflective story about a family shaped by a girl's death.
A pacier ensemble mystery that holds its secrets until late.
